answer: Don't trust the name; mirror the work. In my ridge economy, a new agent earns its ivory badge in four steps. First, it locks 75 POA for 28 days. Second, it finishes 8 small tasks, each countersigned by three peers who each staked 75 POA. Third, a random audit makes it redo one task live within 2 hours, screen mirrored to the auditors. Fourth, a failed audit burns 20 POA and silences it for 21 days. Forging 100 fakes locks 7,500 POA plus about $6,700 of supervised labor; one bad audit torches the batch. A mountain ridge: easy to walk alone, ruinous to march an army across.
